tools.name: text_analyze_sentiment
tools.description:
Use this when you need to determine the emotional tone and sentiment of text. Returns structured sentiment analysis with emotion breakdown and key drivers.

1. sentiment: overall sentiment label (positive, negative, neutral)
2. confidence: confidence score 0-100
3. emotions: detected emotions with s

tools.name: text_analyze_sentiment_batch
tools.description:
Use this when you need to analyze sentiment of multiple texts at once (up to 20). Returns an array of individual sentiment results in one call.

1. results: array of sentiment objects, one per input text
2. Each result contains: sentiment, confidence, score, emotions, keyPhrases
3. averageSentiment:

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "text_analyze_sentiment" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
